theme_and_concept.vibe: Prestigious, cinematic, moody, wealthy, traditional yet modern
theme_and_concept.theme_preference: Dark theme primary (Deep greens and gold), simulating an exclusive old-money library or archive.

typography.strategy: Old Money Tech - Classic Serif Headings + Clean Sans Body

headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers, Book Titles. MUST use tracking-tight for sizes > 32px.

mono.usage: Darussalam Codes (e.g. C21, E20), Tier labels, specific UI metadata.

typesetting_rules.headlines: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
typesetting_rules.overlines: MUST be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
typesetting_rules.line_height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, Loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
typesetting_rules.text_alignment: Headings center-aligned only for Hero. Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and standard content.

primary.usage: Brand core, main backgrounds, solid large surfaces.

accent.usage: CTAs, Tier 5 highlights, active states, premium borders.

rules.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Use text-shadow over images.
rules.gradients: NO generic flat gradients. Use subtle radial glows for gold accents behind premium books.

surface_strategy.navigation: The 'Crystal' Variant (Glassmorphism): bg-[#02120F]/70, backdrop-blur-xl, backdrop-saturate-150, border-b border-[#D4AF37]/20.
surface_strategy.cards: Neumorphism tactile variant, bg-[#05201A], sharp 1px border-[#D4AF37]/20, hover lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg shadow-[#D4AF37]/10.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain/noise overlays to make the dark green feel like velvet or premium leather, not flat digital pixels.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use gold-tinted semi-transparent borders (border-[#D4AF37]/20) for definition.

icons.style: Duotone weight for marketing pages, Regular for dashboard. Gold or Cream colored.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.

home_grid.implementation: Section title (Tier/Category) left-aligned. Horizontal flex container with snap-x snap-mandatory, gap-6, hide scrollbar. Items are min-w-[200px] md:min-w-[240px].

dashboard_grid.pattern: High Density Grid for Admin Panel.
dashboard_grid.implementation: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-6. Direct children only. Use h-full on children.

components.button: Pill-shaped or rounded-sm with sharp hover interactions. Gold CTAs MUST have hover state explicitly defined (e.g. hover:bg-[#E9C85C] hover:text-[#02120F]).
components.cards: Use customized Shadcn UI cards without the generic Vercel look. Override borders to be dark/gold-tinted.
components.pdf_viewer: Full-width embedded viewer. Background #02120F. Controls in a glassmorphic floating toolbar.
components.form_inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized. bg-[#082E26] border-[#D4AF37]/20 text-[#FDFBF7] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] rounded-sm.
components.toast: Use Sonner, positioned bottom-right, styled dark with gold borders.

motion.hover: Smooth transform (-translate-y-1, scale-105 for book covers) with transition-transform 0.3s ease.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for book grids. Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Use specific properties.
motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for accessibility.

accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='read-now-button', data-testid='book-search-input').
accessibility.focus_states: Focus states must have higher contrast, e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] focus:outline-none.
accessibility.contrast: Adhere to APCA contrast requirements. Gold on dark green usually passes, check cream on gold.

media.image_constraints: Mobile Hero images max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none. Books covers must maintain consistent aspect ratio (usually 2:3).

image_urls.description: Premium library with dark wooden shelves and warm lighting.
image_urls.placement: Landing Page Hero Background (with heavy dark green overlay)

image_urls.description: Cozy inviting library scene for community feel.
image_urls.placement: About Us or Ship-to-Scan portal header background

image_urls.description: Ornate gold floral pattern on dark leather book cover.
image_urls.placement: Placeholder for Tier 4/5 books or Volume categories.
Bookshelf placeholders or generic book list images.

libraries_and_packages.carousel: Use native CSS snap-x for best performance on mobile, or 'embla-carousel-react' (built into Shadcn).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install custom fonts 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' via Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
DO NOT build HTML native select or date pickers. ALWAYS use Shadcn.
Override default Shadcn styles in tailwind.config.js to map 'primary' to gold, 'background' to dark green/black.
Ensure 'Book Tier' permission checks happen visually (locks on covers) and logically (disabling the Read Now button).
The 15-book bookshelf limit for Tier 1 must be visually communicated (e.g. '12/15 Books Saved' progress bar).
For 'Ship-to-Scan' portal, use an exclusive luxury design. Only accessible if user_tier == 5.
For Book Covers in the Netflix grid, use aspect-[2/3] and object-cover to prevent layout shifts.
Use standard named exports for components, default exports for pages.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
